description.zh: 投篮的弧线就是抛物线：y = ax² 里 a 决定开口方向和胖瘦，写成顶点式 y = a(x − h)² + k 后顶点 (h, k) 和对称轴 x = h 一眼可读；图像与 x 轴有两个、一个或没有交点，就是 y = 0 有两个、一个或没有实数解。
description.en: A basketball’s arc is a parabola: in y = ax², a sets the opening direction and width; in vertex form y = a(x − h)² + k the vertex (h, k) and the axis x = h can be read off directly; crossing the x-axis twice, once or not at all means y = 0 has two, one or no real solutions.

label.en: A thrown ball follows a parabola

reason.zh: 不计空气阻力时，水平方向匀速、竖直方向匀加速，高度是时间的二次函数，所以轨迹是一条开口向下的抛物线。
reason.en: Ignoring air resistance, horizontal motion is uniform and vertical motion uniformly accelerated, so height is a quadratic function of time and the path is a downward-opening parabola.

label.en: A parabola is also a conic section

reason.zh: y = ax² 的图像正是离心率 e = 1 的圆锥曲线：用平行于圆锥母线的平面去切就得到它，曲线上每一点到焦点和到准线的距离相等。
reason.en: The graph of y = ax² is exactly the conic with eccentricity e = 1: slice a cone parallel to its slant side and you get it, every point equally far from the focus and the directrix.
